comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body:
From Japanese wiki:

"There is a certain probability of avoiding a collision with an enemy ship.
The probability varies depending on the collision angle and speed between your ship and the enemy ship."

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
It's possible to look at this skill under the OSP skill selection for a number of ships. The official translation isn't all that different from the one which CA BlakeC kindly shared, but:

Evade the enemy's collision attack with a certain probability.
The probability varies based on the angle and the speed of your ship and the enemy's ship.
